from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class InvestmentIncomeEntry(BaseModel):
    """One investment income data point from a single report document."""
    year: int | None = Field(description="The fiscal year of the report")
    period_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of period covered: Q1, Q3, etc.")
    period_range: str | None = Field(description="Period range text: e.g. '1-3 months', '1-9 months', or 'single quarter'")
    investment_income: float | None = Field(description="Investment income amount as reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="Unit of the amount: dollars, thousands, millions, etc.")
    is_consolidated: bool | None = Field(description="Whether this is from consolidated financial statements or parent company only")
    report_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of report: Q1, Q3, etc.")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt from the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    investment_income_entries: list[InvestmentIncomeEntry]
